Principle 13: Whom Do I Respect?
Since I was young, I learned to like history books and novels because
I could read about the wisdom of many people.
I have read about many interesting people from these historical texts.
I learned to respect many people from reading a lot of books.
I would like to introduce to you the person I respect the most.
The person I respect the most is General Soon-Shin Lee.
General Lee lived 500 years ago,
and he defeated the Japanese over and over again.
He lived during a difficult time of Korean history,
but he always thought of Korea and Koreans before himself.
He created the turtle ship that he had used against the Japanese
and conquered them many times.
I respect General Lee because he was able to prepare
and execute great military victories.
He was always confident that his soldiers would be successful in battle.
He was very brave and not afraid to die.
To General Lee, duty and responsibility were very important.
One day, I hope to grow up to be as brave and confident as
General Soon-Shin Lee.
